notes.title: Seamon Town TD Two Magic Wands and a Dangerous Pursuit Version 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Seamon Town TD Two Magic Wands and a Dangerous Pursuit

Version 0.2.0 has been released

□Stages 6 and 7 have been added.

□Two new enemies have been added.

□Two new spirits (lightning and light) have been added.

Spirits (lightning and light) cannot be used in Easy mode.

□Normal mode has been released.

You can now play Normal mode for stages 1 to 7.
In Easy mode, you fight using four types of spirits, and in Normal mode, you fight using six types of spirits.

The enemy appearance patterns are also slightly different.

□The difficulty of existing Easy mode stages 1 to 5 has been readjusted.

□Other changes and bug fixes have been made.

For details on each update, please visit the website.
